unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: This is Ben's diary for next week.

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: He is playing tennis on Monday afternoon.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: ten(十) + nis(尼斯) -> 十个人在尼斯打网球。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: He is going to the dentist on Tuesday morning.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: den(洞) + tist(test测试) -> 在牙洞里做测试的牙医。
cin(死因) + e + ma(妈) -> 妈妈去电影院看悬疑片找死因。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We're meeting her at the station.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: sta(呆) + tion(商场) -> 呆在商场旁边的车站。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Steve isn't playing football next Saturday.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: foot(脚) + ball(球) -> 用脚踢的球就是足球。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We use the present simple when we talk about timetables and programmes.

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I have an exam next week.

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Ask Anna about her holiday plans.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: hol(好咧) + i + day(日子) -> 好咧的日子就是假期。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Has Jack moved into his new apartment yet?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: a + part(部分) + ment(名词后缀) -> 房屋的一部分就是公寓。
